chunks: And Zayd al-Shahham said to him:
May I take a pebble out of the mosque?
He said: "Then return it, or place it in another mosque."

key_terms.الْمَسْجِدِ: the mosque, a consecrated place of worship
key_terms.حَصَاةً: a pebble or small stone from the mosque
key_terms.مَسْجِدٍ: another mosque, indicating transfer to a similar sacred space

ai.seo_question: Can you take a pebble or small object out of a mosque?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a ruling concerning respect for mosque property, even in something as small as a pebble. It indicates that what is taken from a mosque should be returned, or at least transferred to another mosque rather than removed for personal use.
